purpose_of_this_fixture: A strong discovery call that follows the method: connection first, frame and honest-expert line, current-state walkthrough, pains excavated in the client's words, why now, a bleed the client calculates and confirms, an upside with a 'what would you go after' answer, desired outcome, decision process, priority, blockers, a first-cut scope check and a dated next step. It tests that the plugin (1) grades R1-R10 Met from client-side verbatim evidence, R11 Missing (no demo yet) and R12 Partial (first-version scope agreed for a demo only, approver absent), giving the verdict 'Discovery complete'; (2) grades per-pain checks with realistic gaps (P3 trajectory missing, P4 only partly excavated); (3) keeps unquantified items (write-off share, principals' time, the lost pursuit fee) out of the bleed total and keeps loaded rates apart from bill rates; (4) picks up client vocabulary (pursuits, fee proposals, jobs, phases, submittals, the Wall, owner); (5) treats the Ajera connection as a must-have while asking about hosting, access and data direction; (6) flags the polite timing hedge and the other ambiguities as questions instead of assumptions; and (7) proposes a CRM plus Work Management blueprint and first build.
transcript_format: Plain text, one speaker turn per line, each formatted '[HH:MM:SS] Speaker Name: text'. Timestamps are turn start times from [00:00:04] to about [00:45:02]. Three speakers: 'Consultant', 'Tess Kowalczyk' (COO) and 'Jordan Pruitt' (Operations Manager). Non-verbal cues appear in square brackets ([laughs], [sighs], [muffled]); interruptions and self-corrections use ' -- '. No header lines. The call date is not stated; the dates mentioned fit a call on Thursday 10 September 2026. Evidence locations in this key are 'HH:MM:SS, Speaker (role)'.
